cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The parcel depot closes at six. Your mother's waiting outside the station. Which am I collecting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then do you want her waiting for me or waiting for her present?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Get the parcel. I'll call her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's calling me now. Shall I pull over to explain, or keep driving before the depot shuts?

mechanism: A corrects B collection planning into a choice between equally urgent obligations, then treats a live call as another task that threatens the chosen deadline.
confusable: Generic busyness complains of workload; A must make B choose explicitly and renew the choice when B solution creates a competing demand.
comparison: Gravy alternative uses continuous cooking attention; depot alternative weighs arrival deadlines and stopping to communicate.
seedUse: Mother at station, birthday parcel and closing depot derive from D34-b; S03 adds precise route and communication distinctions.
